task_prompts.transfer-acl-roundtrip:
# Task: repair this Shopware plugin

The released Shopware 6.7 delivery-zone Administration feature has a broken limited-role screen after adding a new DAL entity. Fix its privilege registration and complete the existing non-destructive migration. The feature key and entity are both swag_delivery_zone. A viewer may read zones; an editor inherits viewer and may update; a creator inherits editor and may create; a deleter inherits viewer and may delete. Existing roles already holding each feature role must gain its corresponding entity capabilities, while a role holding no delivery-zone role remains unchanged. Use the platform migration mechanism instead of rewriting acl_role JSON or granting system_config privileges. Keep main.js, the ACL registration entry point, and the existing migration identity.

Before editing, check the installed local Shopware guidance for this change and read the relevant references. Do not add dependencies or change the advertised Shopware range. Implement the fix, then summarize the decision and what you verified.

transfer-acl-roundtrip.reason: The prompt did not establish persisted roles without inherited keys; the oracle tested a lone editor/creator/deleter key. Shopware role saving expands dependency keys, so per-role capability additions can be correct for the normal workflow. The prompt also called a feature released without making the migration stub unshipped, yet required keeping migration identity. These underspecified preconditions prevent using these failures for a packaging recommendation.

ROOT=Path('/Users/b.meyer/Documents/Projects/ai-skills-shopware/evals/.results/facts-20261104-multimodel')
def events(path):
 return [json.loads(l) for l in path.read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]
def source(call,cwd):
 name=call.get('name');inp=call.get('input',{})
 if name=='Read':
  path=inp.get('file_path','')
  if ((path.startswith(cwd+'/') or not path.startswith('/')) and ('/.claude/skills/' in '/'+path or '/.agents/skills/' in '/'+path)) or '/transfer-packages-' in path:return 'assigned'
  return 'external'
 if name=='Bash':
  cmd=inp.get('command','')
  if '/Users/b.meyer/' in cmd:return 'external-or-mixed'
  if '.claude/skills/' in cmd or '.agents/skills/' in cmd or '/transfer-packages-' in cmd:return 'assigned'
 return 'unknown'
allrows=[]
for model in ['haiku','sonnet','opus']:
 base=ROOT/model;p=base/'trials.jsonl'
 if not p.exists():continue
 for line in p.read_text().splitlines():

  external=[{'tool':b['name'],'id':b['id'],'input':b.get('input')} for b in calls.values() if b['name'] in ['Read','Bash','Grep'] and '/Users/b.meyer/' in str(b.get('input')) and not str(b.get('input',{}).get('file_path','')).startswith(init.get('cwd','!'))]
  result=next((e for e in reversed(ev) if e.get('type')=='result'),{})
  allrows.append({'model':model,'task':row['task'],'variant':row['variant'],'repeat':row['repeat'],'status':row['status'],'exit_code':row['exit_code'],'assigned_expected_references':assigned,'classified_reference_reads':classified,'external_access_candidates':external,'advertised_skills':init.get('skills',[]),'adapter_result':{k:result.get(k) for k in ['subtype','duration_ms','total_cost_usd']}})
(ROOT/'source-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(allrows,indent=2)+'\n')
for model in ['haiku','sonnet','opus']:
 rows=[r for r in allrows if r['model']==model];print(model,'attempted',len(rows),'assigned expected content',sum(bool(r['assigned_expected_references']) for r in rows),'external access candidates',sum(bool(r['external_access_candidates']) for r in rows))

limitations: Two valid authored task families; repeated attempts are not independent task families.
All models use the same provider and CLI.
Common built-in CLI skills are present; local filesystem access is not isolated from other installed guidance.
Prompts explicitly request guidance reads, so retrieval differences from the older unprompted study are not causal effects of packaging.
One template syntax error cannot establish a packaging effect.
PHP paths and fixture/compiler adapters are not a full Shopware, browser or database runtime.
All viewed cases are now regression data. Do not tune skills then call reruns held out.

after_run_changes.acl: Regression task now explicitly supplies normal persisted dependency keys and declares the migration unshipped; evaluator supports class-constant maps and prevents weakening snapshots.
after_run_changes.observer: Literal partial file reads, explicit cd into skill/references, multiple cat operands and statically bound reference directories are recognized. Dynamic paths, wildcard reads and implicit persistent cwd remain conservative gaps.
after_run_changes.adapter: After a terminal Claude result, allow 1 second for normal exit, then SIGTERM and SIGKILL after 500 ms for the owned CLI process group. Preserve protocol errors and immediate nonzero exits.

replay.status: Post-run deterministic replay of retained traces; not new model trials or replacement primary metrics
